headline: Roscoe The Dog Is Bossing The Comp, Mr Overs Just Got Cooked, And Harry Is Fully In The Dregs
intro: Eight to eleven games in, so projections are swinging like a barn door, but Roscoe the Dog has jumped +44.0 to 52.8 and now leads the humans he's meant to be fading. Last week's leader Leon dropped a monstrous −44.3 and slid to third, while Harry fell −46.8 and is holding the spoon at −57.3. Reminder to Harry: the punishment is still on the table, and Roscoe is in a generous mood.

players.name: Roscoe the Dog
players.text: 52.8, up 44.0, and a dog is topping a comp his owners drafted for. The Warriors Over (+16.9) is the star: Curry dropped 41 in an overtime win over the Magic, and that's seven straight for Golden State. The Hawks Over added another 17.0 with Jalen Johnson back and putting up 30 on return. The Heat Under (+19.2, and +20.4 on efficiency) is sitting there like a loaded gun. Roscoe's only wobble is the Nuggets Under, with Spencer Jones back, but it's a rounding error.

players.name: Nic
players.text: 38.9, down 2.7, so Visdog treads water while the dog sprints past. The Bucks and Kings Unders (1-8 each) are still printing, but the Kings Under gave back 9.1 this week, and with De'Andre Hunter back that one needs watching. Thunder Over (+3.1) is barely above water on pace and slightly negative on efficiency, though Shai's 30 in three quarters against the Wizards and the Nique Clifford trade won't hurt. The Knicks Under bled 18.2 after that Brunson and Towns win over the Cavs, and with Josh Hart out it might bleed more.

players.name: Leon
players.text: 24.6, down a brutal 44.3. Mr Overs got the haircut, and the Jazz Over (1-8, −28.4) is now a crime scene, with Trey Alexander back being about as helpful as a screen door on a submarine. The Grizzlies Over still holds +25.2 but shed 27.3 this week, and Memphis are on a three-game skid. Efficiency says he's at 44.3 and the record says 24.6, so the Pistons and Rockets Overs are doing real work, but Clint Capela going out in Houston is a worry. In this comp a single −10 will kill ya, and Leon's got a −28 sitting in his lap.

players.name: Ned
players.text: 13.1, up 18.9, and the best mover among the humans after the dog. The Magic Under is a monster at +25.3 (2-7), the Cavaliers Under swung 13.7 his way, and the Rockets Under added 12.9. But he's got the Thunder Under, the Pistons Under and the Rockets Under all swimming upstream, and the efficiency total of −3.2 says it's thinner than it looks. Jarrett Allen going out in Cleveland is handy for his Cavs Under, though Sam Merrill's absence is the real tell on how banged up that team is. Hang on, Ned.

players.name: Dan
players.text: 12.9, down 12.1, and Doc is doing it the hard way. The Lakers Under is −19.1 with the Lakers at 8-2, and Luka sitting out against the Pistons with lower back tightness is the only lifeline, though there's no timeline yet. The Bulls Over (1-7, −19.2) is a train wreck even with Nic Claxton back, and Norman Powell going out hurts it further. On the bright side, the Clippers Under (+20.2) is cruising and the 76ers Over (+15.1) is great on pace, though efficiency says the Sixers are a mirage at 0.0. Doccy needs the Spurs to keep winning, and they've won eight straight.

players.name: Angus
players.text: 3.5, down 5.3, and Gooey's week was a coin flip that landed on his foot. The Warriors Under (−16.9) is getting flogged by Curry every night, and the Pelicans Under (−8.9) isn't going well with Dejounte Murray back in the lineup. The Lakers Over (+19.1) is carrying him, and Luka's back tightness is a genuine threat to it. The Pacers Under (+19.9) is the one to protect, and T.J. McConnell and Obi Toppin both returning is a quiet problem for it, though Pascal Siakam going out earlier in the week helps.

players.name: Marco
players.text: −20.1, up 5.7, and Marci's in the red but at least heading the right way. The Wolves Over (+8.9) is fine, but the Hornets Over (3-7, −14.9, and −27.0 on efficiency) is a slow-motion disaster, with Schroder and Diabate both going out. The Mavericks Under (−11.1) is under pressure with Santi Aldama back, and the Cavs Over is bleeding −6.5. He's got the Nuggets on both sides of the ledger with Roscoe, which is a sentence nobody wants to read.

players.name: Sam
players.text: −24.2, up 29.5, the biggest human jump of the week, and Sammy is still second-last. The efficiency number is a healthy +24.0, which tells you the Sixers (8-2 but flat on points) and the Hornets Under are better than the record suggests. The Pacers Over (−19.9) is the albatross, though McConnell and Toppin returning gives it a pulse. The Knicks Over added 18.2 after that win over the Cavs, and the Bulls Under (+19.2) took a hit with Claxton back. Sam is slowly dragging himself out of the hole.

players.name: Pos
players.text: −43.2, up 13.1, and Pos is propping up the table with the spoon within a whisker. The Grizzlies Under (−25.2) is the killer, though he clawed back 27.3 of it this week. The Heat Over (−19.2) is the other half of the Roscoe sandwich, and Jalen Johnson back for 30 points on the Hawks keeps the Hawks Under (−8.7) in a headlock. The Jazz Under (+28.4) is his lifeline, but the Spurs Under at 8-2 is another thing sinking him. It's a bleak fortnight.

players.name: Harry
players.text: −57.3, down 46.8, and he's now holding the spoon. Magic Over (−25.3 at 2-7), Clippers Over (−20.2 at 1-7), and the Wolves Under (−8.9 at 7-3) all went the wrong way, and with Desmond Bane going out in Orlando the Magic Over is cooked. The Mavericks Over (+11.1) is the lone bright spot, with Santi Aldama back, but it's hardly a lifeline. A reminder that the punishment is looming, Harry: Roscoe's been very patient, and he's a dog with a plan.

signoff: May your unders tank and your overs thrive!
